preservedResponsibilities: Task188 ports native MsLangId configured data/UI scalar state,getSystemLanguage/getSystemUILanguage,getConfigured getters,getRealLanguage alias/UNKNOWN rules and public Locale conversion/fallback wrappers. Browser platform selection reuses the exact prior prepared Locale algorithm in one lower-level owner,with independent lazy logical data/UI language snapshots and native table fallback;it does not emulate Unix/Win32/RTL ABI or physical caches. Existing live SysLocale field query delegates this preparation and respects actual configured override through an internal field projection,without inventing a LanguageTag/SvtSysLocale service. LocaleData uses actual public getFallbackLocale so empty language resolves configured/system language. Existing private table algorithms and nonempty behavior remain. Full LanguageTag synchronization/canonicalization,script fallbacks,font/pool/document/UI/ODS remain pending;no compiler,generator,probe,new ICU or ownership engine.
omittedResponsibilities: Full LanguageTag and source system/configuration services,script fallbacks,physical OS ABI,font/pool/document/UI/ODS remain pending.
